LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.4: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can be used to enhance reading fluency?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out characters on numbers from flashcards (e.g. 一、二、三 ......十),

2. look at word cards on sequencing of the days of the week in Chinese and read them out loud (星期 一、星期二、星期三、星期四、星期五、星期 六、星期天),

3. arrange jumbled up flash cards of days of the week in the correct sequence collaboratively and read them out loud,

4. work jointly to match days of the week with activities that are undertaken on the corresponding days (e.g. 星期一、去学校、星期五、去清真 寺、周日、去教堂) and read them out in class,

5. assess peers’ pronunciation while reading aloud texts related to time collaboratively.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out characters on numbers from flashcards (e.g. 一、二、三 ......十),
2. look at word cards on sequencing of the days of the week in Chinese and read them out loud (星期 一、星期二、星期三、星期四、星期五、星期 六、星期天),
3. arrange jumbled up flash cards of days of the week in the correct sequence collaboratively and read them out loud,
4. work jointly to match days of the week with activities that are undertaken on the corresponding days (e.g. 星期一、去学校、星期五、去清真 寺、周日、去教堂) and read them out in class,
5. assess peers’ pronunciation while reading aloud texts related to time collaboratively.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner contributes to group decision making as they actively participate in arranging

flash cards on days of the week in the correct sequence.

Values:
Unity: The learner exhibits team spirit as they collaborate with peers to match days of the week with activities undertaken on the

corresponding days.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner develops an awareness of their strengths and weaknesses in pronunciation through peer assessment

as they read days of the week.

Link to other learning areas: The learner links their learning to Mathematics on the concept of counting numbers when reading

days of the week.
